description: This file implements AI logic for a Tic-Tac-Toe game, providing functions for different difficulty levels including random move selection, heuristic-based move, and minimax algorithm for optimal play.

methods.name: randomOf(arr)
methods.description: Selects a random element from an array, or null if empty.

methods.name: opponent(p)
methods.description: Returns the opposing player symbol ('X' or 'O').

methods.name: level2(board, player)
methods.description: Heuristic AI for level 2 difficulty: attempts to win, then block, then prioritizes center, corners, and edges with some randomness.

methods.name: minimax(board, player, maximizingPlayer, depth = 0)
methods.description: Implements the minimax algorithm for 3x3 Tic-Tac-Toe, providing the optimal move evaluation.

methods.name: getBestMove(board, player, level = 1)
methods.description: Main exported function that selects the best move based on the specified difficulty level (1=random, 2=heuristic, 3=minimax).
